# MoneySpent - Personal Finance & Expense Tracker

## What is MoneySpent?
MoneySpent is a simple, private personal finance tracker for expenses, budgets, accounts, balances, and spending insights. It helps you log spending in seconds, stay on budget, and know exactly where your money goes.

## Key Statistics & Facts
- Over 2,000+ happy users track their money with MoneySpent.
- MoneySpent is completely free for personal use ($0/month).
- 100% private, on-device data. No ads and no data tracking.

## Features
- Unlimited manual transactions
- Track multiple accounts & cards
- Smart category management
- Personalized spending insights

## Use Cases
- Expense tracking
- Budget tracking
- Account balance tracking
- Spending analytics
- Personal finance dashboard

## Links
- Website: https://moneyspent.app
- Pricing: Free forever for personal use.
